Certified operations are plan-review and completion-verifier (routed through MCP and enforceable via trusted-env), while code-review is a Gerrit LLM-Review vote and not an op-cert

docs/mcp-auth.md section 7 must contain the AWS deployment recipe with ADR-named config keys (http_tls_at_edge, auth_static_tokens_file, auth_strategies)
A client-connection guide covering copilot/codex/claude configuration shapes must be linked and reachable from docs/mcp-auth.md
All pre-existing tracker-op 'run rebar locally' instruction surfaces must be reconciled under the MCP umbrella rule or explicitly carved out as local-code operations
